Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Gabriela Tiago
Message:
feat(auth): log in with email and password

POST /auth/login checks the credentials and returns an opaque bearer
token plus the user's role, which the front uses to open the right
panel. Every failure, including inactive users and pending invites,
gets the same message so the response does not reveal which e-mails
exist. Sessions live in the database instead of a JWT so they can be
ended right away, as password reset, session management and user
inactivation will need. GET /auth/me and the CurrentUser dependency
let other routes require login.

Refs: US02-CA01, US02-CA02, US02-CA03
